mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.content, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.edited_at, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.icon_key AS author_icon_key FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
